description: The person's approvals of a product's bank, at @worktrees/banked/<product>/approvals.json, newest last. One approval covers one queue: it records who approved, when, the queue hash it approved (scripts/bank.mjs#queueHash) and the missions that queue listed. That one answer counts as the goal-confirm of every mission the queue names, so a session opened from a banked entry prints its goal block and does not wait. The hash is what keeps the approval honest: adding, reordering or dropping an entry changes it, the approval stops being current, and the next mission asks the person again. A mission whose goal the person corrects at open time is re-confirmed on its own, the bank entry is rewritten, and the hash the approval carries is stale by construction.

choice.description: bank:<product>:v<n>, the decision id the session records the way it records a goal-confirm

who.description: the person who approved, by the name the session knows them by; never a credential and never an address
